_meta.description: Toyota Camry dashboard indicator knowledge base. One entry per light/message the vision model can report. Drives both the detector prompt (ids + visual descriptions) and the reliability scorer (penalties + performance effects).

severity_scale.info: Status indicator only; no fault implied.
severity_scale.low: Minor issue or maintenance reminder; little/no effect on driving.
severity_scale.medium: Fault in a supporting system; car drives but a safety or efficiency system may be degraded.
severity_scale.high: Fault in a core system; drive only to a repair shop, damage or safety risk if ignored.
severity_scale.critical: Stop driving as soon as it is safe; continued driving risks major damage or loss of control.

_meta.performance_scale: 0 = no effect, 1 = slight, 2 = noticeable, 3 = significant, 4 = severe/unsafe
_meta.reliability_penalty: Points subtracted from a 100-point reliability score when the light is detected ON in a running-engine photo. Flashing multiplies by flashing_multiplier.
_meta.repair_cost_usd: Rough independent-shop ranges for the most common Camry causes. For rating only, not quotes.
_meta.bulb_check_note: All lights glow for ~3 s at key-on (bulb check). Only score photos taken with the engine running, or where the odometer/trip display shows the car is fully on and the lights stay lit.

lights.name: Check Engine / Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL)
lights.visual: Amber engine-block outline (side view of a motor). Older Camrys may show the text CHECK ENGINE.
performance_effects: ECU may run in limp/fail-safe mode with reduced power
Rough idle or hesitation on misfire codes
Fuel economy drops 5-25% on O2/MAF/thermostat faults
Flashing = active misfire: unburned fuel can destroy the catalytic converter
common_camry_causes: Ignition coil or spark plug misfire (P0300-P0306)
lights.action: Read the OBD-II code before buying. Flashing: avoid driving; get it towed or repaired immediately.

lights.name: Low Oil Pressure
lights.visual: Red oil can with a drip falling from the spout.
performance_effects: Bearings and cam surfaces lose lubrication within seconds to minutes
Knocking/ticking, then engine seizure
Engine failure while driving can cause loss of power on the road
common_camry_causes: Low oil level (very common on 2007-2009 2AZ-FE oil consumers)
Failed oil pump or clogged pickup
Faulty oil pressure switch (cheap false alarm)
lights.action: Stop the engine. Check oil level. Do not drive until pressure is confirmed with a gauge.

lights.name: Charging System / Battery
lights.visual: Red rectangle battery icon with + and - terminals on top.
performance_effects: Car runs on battery only; stalls once the battery drains (often 30-60 min)
Electric power steering, lights and ABS weaken as voltage drops
On hybrids: DC-DC converter or 12V auxiliary battery fault
lights.action: Turn off accessories and drive straight to a shop. Test battery and alternator output.

lights.name: High Coolant Temperature
lights.visual: Red thermometer standing in wavy liquid lines. Newer Camrys show a blue version of the same icon when the engine is cold (that is coolant_temp_cold).
performance_effects: Engine overheating; ECU may cut power
Risk of warped cylinder head / blown head gasket
A/C may be disabled to reduce load
lights.action: Pull over and shut the engine off. Do not open a hot radiator cap.

lights.name: Low Coolant Temperature (engine cold)
lights.visual: Blue thermometer in wavy liquid lines. Normal after a cold start; goes out once warm.
performance_effects: Normal during warm-up. If it stays on after 15+ min of driving, thermostat may be stuck open (poor heat, lower MPG).
lights.action: None unless it stays on after the engine should be warm.

lights.name: Brake System Warning
lights.visual: Red circle with an exclamation mark inside, between two curved brackets: (!). Often accompanied by the word BRAKE on older Camrys.
performance_effects: Low brake fluid or hydraulic fault: longer stopping distances
Can also mean the parking brake is still engaged (not a fault)
common_camry_causes: Low brake fluid from worn pads
lights.action: Confirm parking brake is fully released. If still on, check fluid; do not drive with a soft pedal.

lights.name: Anti-lock Brake System (ABS)
lights.visual: Amber circle containing the letters ABS, with curved brackets on each side.
performance_effects: Normal brakes work, but wheels can lock in hard stops
VSC and traction control are usually disabled with it
lights.action: Safe to drive gently; scan ABS codes. Increase following distance.

lights.name: SRS Airbag
lights.visual: Red seated person with a seatbelt and a large circle (airbag) in front. Older Camrys show the text SRS or SRS AIRBAG.
performance_effects: Airbags and pretensioners may not deploy in a crash
No effect on driving feel
lights.action: Car drives normally but crash protection is compromised. Check accident history.

lights.name: Tire Pressure Monitoring (TPMS)
lights.visual: Amber horseshoe-shaped tire cross-section with an exclamation mark in the middle. Flashing ~1 min then solid = TPMS sensor fault.
performance_effects: Under-inflation increases braking distance and tire wear
~0.5-3% MPG loss
common_camry_causes: Dead TPMS sensor battery (8-12 yr old cars)
lights.action: Check and inflate tires to the door-jamb spec.

lights.name: VSC / Traction Control Malfunction (Slip indicator stays on)
lights.visual: Amber car with two squiggly skid lines behind it, lit steadily. Toyota also shows the text VSC or TRAC on older clusters.
performance_effects: No stability or traction intervention on slippery roads
Often appears together with check_engine because Toyota disables VSC on engine faults
common_camry_causes: Triggered by an engine fault (scan the engine first)
lights.action: Scan codes; if check_engine is also on, fix that first.

lights.name: VSC OFF / TRAC OFF indicator
lights.visual: Amber skidding car with the word OFF below it, or text VSC OFF / TRAC OFF.
performance_effects: Driver switched stability control off. Not a fault, but turn it back on.
lights.action: Press the VSC OFF button to re-enable.

lights.name: Electric Power Steering (EPS)
lights.visual: Steering wheel with an exclamation mark beside it (red or amber).
performance_effects: Steering assist reduced or lost: heavy steering at low speed
lights.action: Drive carefully to a shop; check battery voltage first.

lights.name: Low Fuel
lights.visual: Amber fuel pump icon.
performance_effects: Refuel soon. Repeatedly running near-empty can shorten fuel pump life.
lights.action: Refuel.

lights.name: Seatbelt Reminder
lights.visual: Red seated person wearing a diagonal seatbelt (no airbag circle).
performance_effects: Unbuckled occupant. Not a vehicle fault.
lights.action: Buckle up.

lights.name: Door Ajar
lights.visual: Red top-down car outline with one or more doors drawn open.
performance_effects: A door/trunk is open. A light that stays on with doors closed suggests a bad latch switch.
lights.action: Close doors; check latch switch if it persists.

lights.name: Master Warning
lights.visual: Triangle with an exclamation mark inside. Red or amber. Always paired with a text message on the multi-information display (MID).
performance_effects: Generic warning; read the accompanying MID message for the real issue
common_camry_causes: See MID message (hybrid system, low oil, AT oil temp, PCS unavailable, etc.)
lights.action: Read the MID message; score that message as well.

lights.name: Maintenance Required (MAINT REQD)
lights.visual: Amber text MAINT REQD, or a wrench icon on newer Camrys.
performance_effects: Oil change interval reached (5,000 mi older / 10,000 mi synthetic on 2018+). Overdue oil accelerates wear.
lights.action: Ask for service records; overdue oil changes are a red flag on 2AZ-FE engines.

lights.name: Check Hybrid System (MID message)
lights.visual: MID text 'Check Hybrid System' (often with the master warning triangle or a red car-with-exclamation icon). Camry Hybrid only.
performance_effects: Car may enter limp mode or refuse to go into READY
Large MPG loss if the HV battery is degrading
lights.action: Get a hybrid health check (battery block voltages) before buying.

lights.name: AT Oil Temp (transmission overheating)
lights.visual: MID text 'AT OIL TEMP' or 'Transmission Fluid Temp High', or a gear with a thermometer.
performance_effects: Transmission may hold gears or slip
Overheated fluid shortens transmission life
lights.action: Stop and let it cool. Check ATF condition and service history.

lights.name: Pre-Collision System (PCS) warning
lights.visual: Amber icon of two cars about to collide with a star, or text PCS / 'Pre-Collision System Unavailable'. 2015+ with Toyota Safety Sense.
performance_effects: Automatic emergency braking and collision alerts unavailable
lights.action: Clean sensors; if it persists, check for front-end collision repair.

lights.name: Low Washer Fluid
lights.visual: Amber windshield outline with a dashed spray fountain.
performance_effects: Refill washer fluid.
lights.action: Refill.
